Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Status of the account management instruction that was previously received.

StatusReason.name: Status Reason
StatusReason.definition: Reason for the status of the account management instruction.

AccountApplicationIdentification.name: Account Application Identification
AccountApplicationIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier of the account opening or modification instruction at application level.

ExistingAccountIdentification.name: Existing Account Identification
ExistingAccountIdentification.definition: Account to which the account opening is related.

AccountIdentification.name: Account Identification
AccountIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification for the account between the account owner and the account servicer.

BlockedStatus.name: Blocked Status
BlockedStatus.definition: Specifies the account is blocked and other factors for the blocked account.

FATCAReportingDate.name: FATCA Reporting Date
FATCAReportingDate.definition: Date provided by the account owner to inform the account servicer of the date on which the holdings must be reported before the account is subsequently closed.

CRSReportingDate.name: CRS Reporting Date
CRSReportingDate.definition: Date provided by the account owner to inform the account servicer of the date on which the holdings must be reported before the account is subsequently closed.
